question: Who did Rohit Sharma surpass to become India’s third-highest run-getter in One Day Internationals (ODIs)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sourav Ganguly.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Rohit Sharma surpassed Sourav Ganguly to become India's third-highest run-getter in ODIs with 11,249 runs in 275 matches.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Rohit Sharma's knock of 73 runs off 97 balls in the second ODI helped him surpass Ganguly’s tally of 11,121 runs.
 
• **Rohit Sharma's ODI career spans 275 matches, where he has scored 11,249 runs at an average of 48.69, including 32 centuries.**
 
• **Sourav Ganguly had accumulated 11,121 runs in 308 matches with an average of 40.95 and 22 centuries.**
 
• **At the top, Sachin Tendulkar holds the highest record with 18,426 runs, followed by Virat Kohli with 14,181 runs.**
 
• **Rohit Sharma's achievement highlights his consistency and his impact on India's cricketing legacy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rohit Sharma's ODI Career**__

 __
 
• Rohit has been a key player for India with 32 centuries, including the highest individual score of 264 in ODIs.
 
• Known for his attacking style, he has evolved into a reliable opener for India, contributing significantly to his team's success in major tournaments.
 
 
 
• **Sourav Ganguly's Legacy**__
 __
 
• Ganguly played a crucial role in the early 2000s, leading India with pride and performing consistently with the bat, including 22 centuries in ODIs.
 
 
 
• **Virat Kohli’s Impact**__
 
 
• Virat Kohli, with 51 centuries, has been one of the most consistent and successful batsmen in the history of ODIs, with over 14,000 runs to his name.
